description: issue #689 (checker parity with the runtime's isPrimitiveName guard #403): `define beep ... end` redefines `beep`, a Sound primitive (spec/interaction-events.md). The static checker flags the procedure name at its own span. SCOPE, CORRECTED: this used to say the verdict is "gated on the active `sound` profile", which describes shipped behaviour rather than the rule. `spec/grammar.md:408` makes the primitives of every optional profile built-in names UNCONDITIONALLY -- what a profile decides is whether a name WORKS, never whether a program may declare it -- so a conforming 0.4.0 implementation raises here with or without `sound` claimed, and this fixture's ACTIVE-profile assertion is correct for both readings. The Core-only direction is the one still pinned to shipped behaviour; retiring that gate is issue #841. Issue #838 dropped the `namespace: "primitive"` param (spec/error-model.md:125).
